card.name: The word a before glass of water
card.fires_on: The word "a" right after "with" in swallow-with-water instructions, as in "swallow whole with a glass of water". Weak, scattered hits on other words elsewhere.

modes.label: Swallow with a glass
modes.description: The article "a" after "with" in directions to swallow capsules or tablets with water.
modes.example: Swallow the FOTIVDA capsule whole with<< a>> glass of water.

modes.label: Stray hits
modes.description: Occasional unrelated words such as "doses" or part of a name or number.
modes.example: as does the use of sedative-hypnotics at<< doses>> exceeding the maximum recommended dose.

card.writes: It pushes toward the French and Spanish article "une/una" and away from "a" and Chinese words for "a bit", so it makes little sense as an English output.
card.plain: It marks the little word "a" in "take with a glass of water" instructions.
